description: Messages peers send about the tree: { type: 'get', query } -> { type: 'result', tree }; { type: 'put', path, branch } -> { type: 'ok' }; failures -> { type: 'error', message }.

added.put(tree, path, branch): Replaces the owned branch at path with a newer signed copy (same owner, bigger seq, valid signatures). Keeps our copies of delegated branches that are newer. Async.

2.notes: Uses Tree v2 and Query v2; put looks up the branch owner in the entities lists above it.
